annotations.sgw-01/scope: One disclosed zero-request infrastructure recovery; same six requests; native configuration unchanged

args:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir "$OUT"
exec > >(tee "$OUT/job.log") 2>&1
cd "$SOURCE"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 383beb7447170a505d33059c6be46e9ba363ec58
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(sha256sum "$REGISTRATION" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = efa2fa67f7b797f1d56b388aeecc595ab7598473c41b00a5e6fee9145e498919
test "$(sha256sum "$AUX/manifest.json" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 9ec7c8ab51b9081fdbfe74808eabae4194f13d75775145d38246e176078c9bac
test "$(sha256sum "$AUX/cpu-preflight.json" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 37d10767663f4ea3254838bf1fa2d95f1f3b87384f830697638bd3f6f86992f8
export PYTHONPATH="$SOURCE:$SGW01_NANO_SOURCE_ROOT"
export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$OUT/cache" TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR="$OUT/cache/torchinductor" SGW01_NANO_OUTPUT_DIR="$OUT/native-loader"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache" "$XDG_CACHE_HOME"
"$PY" tools/validate_vla_wam_v3_protocol.py --quiet
"$PY" tools/validate_vla_wam_v2_protocol.py > "$OUT/v2-validation.json"
"$PY" - "$OUT" "$AUX" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, shutil, sys, time
from experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.family_campaign_executor import _fsync_json
out,aux=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
prior=out.parent/"run-cz"
owner=json.loads((out.parent/"request-owner/owner.json").read_text())
pod=json.loads((aux/"prior-pod.json").read_text())
assert owner["pod_uid"]==pod["metadata"]["uid"]=="df31b5db-4cf8-4f46-b904-29475d005923"
assert pod["status"]["phase"]=="Failed"
assert all("terminated" in row["state"] for row in pod["status"]["containerStatuses"])
assert json.loads((prior/"process-outcome.json").read_text())["exit_code"]==1
assert json.loads((prior/"evidence/failure.json").read_text())["model_requests_started"]==0
assert not list((prior/"evidence").glob("request-*/intent.json"))
assert not (prior/"evidence/trace.jsonl").exists()
assert not (prior/"evidence/loaded-runtime.json").exists()
assert json.loads((aux/"cpu-preflight.json").read_text())["status"]=="native_auxiliary_constructors_passed_offline_on_cpu"
manifest=json.loads((aux/"manifest.json").read_text())
assert manifest["status"]=="native_auxiliary_assets_downloaded_and_hashed"
for asset in manifest["assets"]:
    for row in asset["files"]:
        path=Path(asset["snapshot"])/row["path"]
        assert path.stat().st_size==row["bytes"]
        sha=hashlib.sha256()
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(8*1024*1024),b""):
                sha.update(block)
        assert sha.hexdigest()==row["sha256"]
free=shutil.disk_usage(out).free; required=4144643440640
_fsync_json(out/"storage.json",{"free_bytes":free,"required_free_bytes":required,"observed_at_unix":time.time(),"status":"passed" if free>=required else "blocked"})
if free<required: raise RuntimeError("persistent storage reserve unavailable")
_fsync_json(out/"recovery-preflight.json",{"status":"prior_owner_terminal_zero_requests_auxiliary_assets_verified","prior_owner":owner,"prior_output":str(prior),"maximum_remaining_requests":6,"additional_request_allocation":0,"runtime_configuration_changed":False,"behavioral_episodes":0})
PY
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$("$PY" -m experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.gpu_idle_probe --expected-count 1 --output "$OUT/idle.json")
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
test "$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name --format=csv,noheader -i "$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")" = "NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB"
exec 9>"/data/users/ali/sgw-01/locks/gpu-$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.lock"
flock --nonblock 9
mkdir "$CLAIM"
"$PY" - "$CLAIM" "$OUT" <<'PY'
import json,os,sys
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.family_campaign_executor import _fsync_json
claim,out=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
_fsync_json(claim/"owner.json",{"pod_name":os.environ["POD_NAME"],"pod_uid":os.environ["POD_UID"],"source_commit":"383beb7447170a505d33059c6be46e9ba363ec58","registration_id":"SGW-N3-FIXED-20260923CW","predecessor_owner":str(claim.parent/"owner.json"),"recovery_output":str(out),"idle":json.loads((out/"idle.json").read_text()),"maximum_model_requests":6,"additional_request_allocation":0,"behavioral_episodes":0})
PY
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,uuid,driver_version,memory.total,memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader > "$OUT/gpu-identity.csv"
set +e
"$PY" -u -m experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.nano_fixed_input --registration "$REGISTRATION" --output "$OUT/evidence"
RC=$?
set -e
"$PY" - "$OUT" "$RC" <<'PY'
import sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.family_campaign_executor import _fsync_json
_fsync_json(Path(sys.argv[1])/"process-outcome.json",{"exit_code":int(sys.argv[2]),"completed_at_unix":time.time(),"behavioral_episodes":0,"request_count_authority":"evidence per-request intents/results and trace, never launcher exit","retry_permitted":False})
PY
sync
exit "$RC"
containers.name: fixed-input
